import hashlib,json,os,subprocess,sys
from pathlib import Path
from datetime import datetime,timezone
root=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
sys.path.insert(0,str(root))
from tools.common import read_json,write_json,machine_id,utc_now
commit='076360191607f282a4c0cdb8500c4b1d13971493'
batch='resumed-low-auto-7-20261025'
checkpoint=root/f'runtime/checkpoint-{batch}.json'
receipt=read_json(checkpoint)
assert receipt['commit']==commit and receipt['status']=='pushed_verification_pending'
state=read_json(root/'runtime/resume-low-20261025/publisher-state.json')
assert state['status']=='stopped_requires_reconciliation_no_image_replay'
for name in ['runtime/master-git-readback.lock','runtime/production-publish.lock','runtime/resume-low-20261025/publisher.lock']:
    assert not (root/name).exists(),name
observation=read_json(root/'runtime/resume-low-20261025/raw-mismatch-observation.json')
assert all(not x['all_index_tree_size_problems'] and x['target_actual_sha256']==observation['target_sha256'] for x in observation['commits'])
audit_rel='mod_nailong/data/production-checkpoint-failures/20261025-auto7-readback-reconciliation.json'
audit_path=root/audit_rel
assert not audit_path.exists()
files={}
for rel in [f'runtime/checkpoint-{batch}.json',f'runtime/master-readback-{batch}.json','runtime/resume-low-20261025/publisher-state.json','runtime/resume-low-20261025/raw-mismatch-observation.json']:
    raw=(root/rel).read_bytes()
    files[rel]={'sha256':hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest(),'bytes':len(raw),'json':json.loads(raw)}
audit={'schema':'low-git-readback-reconciliation-v1','machine_id':machine_id(),'observed_at_utc':utc_now(),'fixed_commit':commit,'scope':'Local Git readback failure only. Original failure receipts preserved below before retry. No image generation, image replay, PNG rewrite, index changes or public-history changes. Single target bytes and complete committed tree path/size metadata rechecked; complete readback is still pending. Underlying first failure cause is unestablished.','prior_evidence':files,'status':'readback_retry_prepared'}
write_json(audit_path,audit)
receipt.setdefault('verification_retry_history',[]).append({'prepared_at_utc':utc_now(),'prior_status':receipt['status'],'evidence':audit_rel,'retry':'Same fixed commit via ordinary publisher; remote-presence check before any push, full pinned original verification remains mandatory.'})
write_json(checkpoint,receipt)
log=root/'runtime/resume-low-20261025/auto7-readback-retry.log'
with log.open('xb') as stream:
    child=subprocess.Popen([sys.executable,str(root/'tools/production_checkpoint_publish.py'),commit,batch],cwd=root,stdout=stream,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,creationflags=subprocess.CREATE_NO_WINDOW)
audit.update(status='readback_retry_started',retry_process_id=child.pid,retry_started_at_utc=utc_now(),retry_log=log.relative_to(root).as_posix())
write_json(audit_path,audit)
print(json.dumps({k:audit[k] for k in ['status','fixed_commit','retry_process_id','retry_started_at_utc','retry_log']}))

"""Resume the same finite Git-only scope after the audited readback recheck."""
import hashlib,json,os,subprocess,sys,time,traceback
from datetime import datetime,timedelta,timezone
from pathlib import Path
root=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
sys.path.insert(0,str(root))
from tools.common import ROOT,read_json,write_json,machine_id,utc_now
folder=ROOT/'runtime/resume-low-20261025'
state_path=folder/'publisher-state.json'
state=read_json(state_path)
assert state['status']=='stopped_requires_reconciliation_no_image_replay'
assert state['run_id']=='resume-20261025-large-logical-queue-v5'
audit_path=ROOT/'mod_nailong/data/production-checkpoint-failures/20261025-auto7-readback-reconciliation.json'
audit=read_json(audit_path)
assert audit['fixed_commit']=='076360191607f282a4c0cdb8500c4b1d13971493'
assert hashlib.sha256(state_path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()==audit['prior_evidence']['runtime/resume-low-20261025/publisher-state.json']['sha256']
deadline=datetime.fromisoformat(state['started_at_utc'])+timedelta(seconds=23400)
assert datetime.now(timezone.utc)<deadline
lock=folder/'publisher.lock'
fd=os.open(lock,os.O_CREAT|os.O_EXCL|os.O_WRONLY)
os.write(fd,str(os.getpid()).encode('ascii'));os.close(fd)
state.update(pid=os.getpid(),resumed_at_utc=utc_now(),original_deadline_utc=deadline.isoformat(),prior_failure_evidence=audit_path.relative_to(ROOT).as_posix(),prior_error=state.pop('error',None))
def persist(**kw):state.update(kw,observed_at_utc=utc_now());write_json(state_path,state)
def checked(args,timeout=1800):
    result=subprocess.run(args,cwd=ROOT,capture_output=True,text=True,encoding='utf-8',errors='replace',timeout=timeout)
    if result.returncode:raise RuntimeError(result.stdout+'\n'+result.stderr)
    return result.stdout
try:
    target=ROOT/'runtime/checkpoint-resumed-low-auto-7-20261025.json'
    while datetime.now(timezone.utc)<deadline:
        proof=read_json(target)
        if proof['status']=='committed_pushed_and_originals_verified':break
        readback=read_json(ROOT/'runtime/master-readback-resumed-low-auto-7-20261025.json')
        if readback.get('status')=='failed' and readback['started_at_utc']>=audit['retry_started_at_utc']:
            raise RuntimeError('Audited same-commit readback recheck failed; preserve failure, no new snapshot')
        persist(status='waiting_for_audited_fixed_commit_readback',last_completed_requests=105)
        time.sleep(20)
    else:raise TimeoutError('Original finite publisher deadline while waiting for readback')
    assert proof['commit']==audit['fixed_commit']
    audit.update(status='readback_retry_verified',verified_at_utc=utc_now(),verified_checkpoint_sha256=hashlib.sha256(target.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),remote_original_readback=proof['remote_original_readback'],scope_after_recheck='Complete fixed-commit readback passed on this recheck. Prior failed receipts and original cause uncertainty remain preserved; no image call or PNG rewrite occurred.')
    write_json(audit_path,audit)
    last=105
    persist(status='reconciled_checkpoint_pushed_and_raw_bytes_verified',last_checkpoint_requests=last,last_commit=proof['commit'])
    while datetime.now(timezone.utc)<deadline:
        owner_path=ROOT/'runtime/rolling-production/owner.json'
        live=owner_path.exists() and read_json(owner_path).get('run_id')==state['run_id']
        production=read_json(ROOT/('runtime/rolling-production/'+state['run_id']+'.json'))
        calls=production['completed_source_requests'];running=live and production['status']=='running'
        if calls-last<16 and running:
            persist(status='waiting_for_next_16_completed_requests',last_completed_requests=calls,last_checkpoint_requests=last)
            time.sleep(20);continue
        if last==calls and not running:break
        readback_lock=ROOT/'runtime/master-git-readback.lock'
        if readback_lock.exists():
            persist(status='waiting_for_existing_original_readback',last_completed_requests=calls)
            time.sleep(20);continue
        seq=len(state['checkpoints'])+1;batch='resumed-low-auto-'+str(seq)+'-20261025'
        while (ROOT/'runtime/low-scoped-checkpoints'/batch).exists():
            seq+=1;batch='resumed-low-auto-'+str(seq)+'-20261025'
        persist(status='snapshotting_LOW_scope',last_completed_requests=calls)
        checked([sys.executable,'-X','utf8',str(ROOT/'runtime/low-scoped-checkpoint-20261025.py'),batch,'--incremental'])
        receipt=read_json(ROOT/'runtime/low-scoped-checkpoints'/batch/'receipt.json')
        publication=ROOT/f'runtime/checkpoint-{batch}.json';assert not publication.exists()
        write_json(publication,{**receipt,'isolated_git_synchronization':{'status':'pending_in_separate_network_publisher','primary_worktree_untouched':True}})
        state['checkpoints'].append({'batch':batch,'commit':receipt['commit'],'completed_requests_at_snapshot':calls,'new_original_PNGs':receipt['new_original_PNGs']})
        while readback_lock.exists():
            if datetime.now(timezone.utc)>=deadline:raise TimeoutError('Original finite publisher deadline; snapshot preserved')
            persist(status='snapshot_committed_waiting_for_prior_raw_readback');time.sleep(20)
        persist(status='publishing_and_verifying_immutable_snapshot')
        checked([sys.executable,str(ROOT/'tools/production_checkpoint_publish.py'),receipt['commit'],batch],timeout=1800)
        assert read_json(publication)['status']=='committed_pushed_and_originals_verified'
        last=calls
        persist(status='checkpoint_pushed_and_raw_bytes_verified',last_checkpoint_requests=last,last_commit=receipt['commit'])
        if not running:break
    persist(status='finished_at_owner_boundary_or_original_deadline',finished_at_utc=utc_now())
except BaseException:
    persist(status='stopped_requires_reconciliation_no_image_replay',error=traceback.format_exc());raise
finally:
    assert lock.read_text()==str(os.getpid());lock.unlink()
